image_description: A close-up, macro shot of a European fire salamander (Salamandra salamandra). The image focuses on the head and upper torso. The subject displays the characteristic glossy black skin with large, irregular bright yellow patches. The eye is visible, appearing dark and protruding. The skin texture appears wet and glandular. A portion of a forelimb is visible in the lower left, showing black skin with small yellow speckles. The background is out-of-focus earthy tones.
